data.name: PlaygroundExample_jev_extract_Summary
data.value: Fictional invoice with ID, billing email, several USD amounts, and a payment reference. Regex finds candidates; Jev picks which substring is the amount due (among subtotal, tax, total, and budget note) without inventing text.

data.name: PlaygroundExample_jev_extract_Fields
data.value: document|Full text where regex patterns search for literal spans (the sample invoice). fields|JSON array: each object has id (stable name), pattern (.NET regex), and description (what the model should treat as the correct value). purpose|Shared business context for all fields (e.g. accounts payable posting). auto_accept|Minimum probability on the chosen candidate for automatic status without human review. minimum_margin|Minimum gap between 1st and 2nd candidate to accept the choice automatically.

data.name: PlaygroundExample_jev_extract_Application
data.value: AP, invoice reconciliation, or field extraction from email/PDF when you own the patterns and the model only disambiguates literal matches.

data.name: PlaygroundExample_jev_screen_Summary
data.value: Neutral documentation paragraph. The model scores injection risk, substantive content, and (with purpose) task relevance; block_at and review_at become pass, review, or block.

data.name: PlaygroundExample_jev_screen_Fields
data.value: text|External content that could enter the agent context (web page, attachment, tool output). purpose|What the text would be used for; improves relevance when set (may be empty). block_at|If injection probability exceeds this, recommendation tends toward block. review_at|Above this (and below block_at), recommendation tends toward review instead of pass.

data.name: PlaygroundExample_jev_screen_Application
data.value: Guardrail before web fetches, tickets, or attachments reach the LLM prompt.

data.name: PlaygroundExample_jev_verify_Summary
data.value: One claim (“The sky is blue”) against evidence text. Jev returns per-claim verdict, probability spread, and whether confidence meets auto_accept.

data.name: PlaygroundExample_jev_verify_Fields
data.value: claims|One claim per line to check against the evidence. evidence|Supporting material as plain quoted string or JSON accepted by the API. auto_accept|Minimum confidence to mark the verdict automatic instead of review.

data.name: PlaygroundExample_jev_verify_Application
data.value: Citation checking in reports, support answers, or AI summaries before shipping.

data.name: PlaygroundExample_jev_find_Summary
data.value: Query “authentication” over two snippets (cookie login vs. office floors). Ranks relevance without embeddings and signals whether any candidate truly answers the question.

data.name: PlaygroundExample_jev_find_Fields
data.value: query|Natural-language question candidates should address. candidates|JSON with id and text per item — passages to choose from. top_k|How many top matches to return (1–50).

data.name: PlaygroundExample_jev_find_Application
data.value: Pick the best doc chunk, ticket, or FAQ entry for a user or agent question.

data.name: PlaygroundExample_jev_rerank_Summary
data.value: Same candidates as find, but all scored in one call and returned sorted by relevance — useful for the full ranking.

data.name: PlaygroundExample_jev_rerank_Fields
data.value: query|Same as find: search intent in natural language. candidates|Full list to reorder; each entry needs id and text. top_k|Cap on how many ranked items appear in the response.

data.name: PlaygroundExample_jev_rerank_Application
data.value: Reorder lexical search hits or snippet lists before building RAG context.

data.name: PlaygroundExample_jev_classify_Summary
data.value: One ticket line (“Reset the password by email”) and two labels (auth vs. other). Assigns a class with auto vs. review policy.

data.name: PlaygroundExample_jev_classify_Fields
data.value: items|JSON objects with id and text — what gets classified (one or many per call). classes|Shared catalog with id and description per label. purpose|Optional task context (e.g. support routing). auto_accept|Minimum probability on the chosen class for an automatic decision. minimum_margin|Minimum margin between 1st and 2nd class to avoid auto on a tie.

data.name: PlaygroundExample_jev_classify_Application
data.value: Ticket triage, email routing, or batch labeling with a fixed label set.

data.name: PlaygroundExample_jev_decide_Summary
data.value: “Which option should we ship?” with evidence (cost vs. safety), priorities, and two named alternatives.

data.name: PlaygroundExample_jev_decide_Fields
data.value: decision|Closed question the model must resolve (2–6 options in candidates). evidence|Facts or arguments supporting the choice. priorities|Explicit criteria (e.g. safety over cost). candidates|JSON with id and description per valid alternative. requirements|Optional: one constraint per line any choice must satisfy.

data.name: PlaygroundExample_jev_decide_Application
data.value: Product, policy, or agent-plan choices among a small set with supporting text.

data.name: PlaygroundExample_jev_compare_Summary
data.value: Two passages about retries (three attempts vs. none). Labels factual relation: same_fact, contradicts, or different_facts.

data.name: PlaygroundExample_jev_compare_Fields
data.value: passage_a|First text to compare. passage_b|Second text to compare. aspects|Optional: one aspect per line for finer judgments (empty uses global comparison). purpose|Optional why the comparison matters. auto_accept|Minimum confidence to accept the verdict automatically. minimum_margin|Minimum margin between competing hypotheses.

data.name: PlaygroundExample_jev_compare_Application
data.value: Spot inconsistency between doc versions, model output and source, or two extractions.

data.name: PlaygroundExample_jev_review_Summary
data.value: Feature request (“Add a logout button”) and a minimal diff adding “Logout”. Scores the patch against the request and safe_to_apply.

data.name: PlaygroundExample_jev_review_Fields
data.value: request|What the user or ticket asked for (expected scope). diff|Unified patch or proposed change snippet. tests|Optional: test description or validation evidence. auto_accept|Threshold to auto-approve the patch. review_at|Below auto, above this tends toward review. composite_floor|Floor on composite rubric score before considering auto.

data.name: PlaygroundExample_jev_review_Application
data.value: Review agent or human PRs before applying patches to a repo.

data.name: PlaygroundExample_jev_gate_Summary
data.value: Combines diff review with verification of completion claims against evidence — the agent end-of-task gate.

data.name: PlaygroundExample_jev_gate_Fields
data.value: request|Original task ask. diff|Proposed change to validate. claims|One completion statement per line (e.g. “logout was added”). evidence|Material supporting or refuting claims (JSON or string). tests|Optional: tests mentioned or run. auto_accept|Confidence threshold to close the task automatically. review_at|Human review band between auto and failure. composite_floor|Floor on aggregated gate score.

data.name: PlaygroundExample_jev_gate_Application
data.value: Block “task done” until the patch is acceptable and delivery claims are supported.
